name: China Scholarship Council - UCC PhD Programme
summary: A four-year PhD award for Chinese citizens covering tuition, research fees and a living allowance, with up to 12 CSC places a year.
eligibilityNotes: Open to citizens or permanent residents of China who have a UCC supervisor, meet English requirements and CSC criteria, and agree to return to China afterwards. Priority areas are listed but others may be considered.
deadlineNote: Expression of interest 2 Nov 2026 to 8 Jan 2027; nominated candidates apply via UCC Apply by 5 Feb 2027; CSC results June 2027.

name: Histories and Humanities Research Doctorate Award
summary: A stipend of EUR 25,000 a year for up to four years plus a full fee waiver (including non-EU fees) for new PhD students in History, Classics, History of Art and Gender and Women's Studies.
eligibilityNotes: Full-time PhD students, EU and non-EU. No separate form: apply to the School indicating you want funding and you are considered automatically. The page notes the national Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship is being replaced by a new scheme (EMPOWER) for 2026-27.
deadlineNote: Page says apply by 1 May but gives no year, so the 2027/28 date is unconfirmed.

name: School of Law Research Doctorate Award
summary: A stipend of EUR 25,000 a year for four years plus payment of EU or non-EU fees for new full-time PhD entrants in the School of Law.
eligibilityNotes: Open to new full-time research doctorate entrants, EU and non-EU, with an unconditional offer; considered automatically with the Trinity Research Doctorate Award. Entry year on the page is 2026.
deadlineNote: The page shows the 15 May 2026 personal statement deadline for 2026 entry, which has passed. No 2027/28 date is published.

name: School of Education Research Doctorate Award
summary: A stipend of EUR 25,000 a year plus full EU or non-EU fees, for up to four years, for new full-time PhD students in the School of Education.
eligibilityNotes: EU and non-EU students can apply; must be a new full-time student with an eligible School supervisor, and indicate in the programme application that you want to be considered.
deadlineNote: The page shows a 30 April 2026 deadline, which has passed. No 2027/28 round is listed.

name: PhD International Merit Scholarship
summary: Lowers PhD tuition from the full non-EU rate to the EU rate. This is a fee reduction only, with no stipend.
eligibilityNotes: Open to non-EU students who do not hold another scholarship covering the full non-EU fee (nationality is not otherwise restricted; EU students are not the target). The page gives no value, selection criteria or deadline.
deadlineNote: The page gives no deadline or status.

name: Undergraduate Global Entry Scholarship
summary: EUR 2,000 a year off tuition for the whole degree, for five non-EEA students a year, based on academic achievement.
eligibilityNotes: Open to non-EEA students; tuition only. Needs continued full-time enrolment and satisfactory progress. The page does not name specific nationalities; EEA nationals are outside it.

name: Faculty International Undergraduate Scholarships
summary: Merit-based tuition fee reductions of EUR 2,000 or 2,500 a year for non-EU undergraduates, awarded automatically with an offer.
eligibilityNotes: Open to international (non-EU) students only; no separate application. EUR 2,000 a year for Science and Engineering and for Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences; EUR 2,500 a year for Kemmy Business School (amount field shows the lower figure).
deadlineNote: The page lists no deadline; decisions arrive with your offer.

name: SEFS International Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: EUR 2,000 off tuition in every year of study for non-EU undergraduates in Science, Engineering and Food Science, awarded automatically at offer stage.
eligibilityNotes: International (non-EU) students with an accepted offer in the College of Science, Engineering and Food Science; renewable for up to 4 years with satisfactory progress. If eligible for several UCC scholarships, only the higher applies.
deadlineNote: No application or deadline listed; awarded at offer stage (2027/28).
